candidates.title: Reward claim/notification revert bricks all vault share operations (DoS)
candidates.description: SiloVault._update runs _claimRewards() (delegatecall to each claiming-logic; reverts on any failure) and _afterTokenTransfer() (calls each notification receiver) on EVERY mint/burn/transfer. A single reverting claiming-logic, notification-receiver, or underlying-market reward claim makes every deposit/withdraw/redeem/transfer revert — a full vault availability loss. removeNotificationReceiver is gated by _allProgramsStopped, so a misbehaving receiver cannot be removed while any program runs.

candidates.title: Reward-component revert is a griefing DoS on all vault withdrawals
candidates.description: Tied to DT-001/RCB-001: any reverting claiming-logic / notification-receiver / underlying-market reward claim makes every deposit/withdraw/redeem/transfer revert. A curator-added market that reverts on reward claim, or a reward token that reverts, freezes user funds; receiver removal is blocked by _allProgramsStopped.

candidates.title: feeShares minting triggers reward notification for feeRecipient (ordering deep pass)
candidates.description: _accrueFee mints fee shares to feeRecipient (_mint→_update→_claimRewards+_afterTokenTransfer) on every deposit/withdraw before the user's action. Whether the feeRecipient's reward accrual on freshly-minted fee shares is credited at the correct (post-mint) index, and whether the double _claimRewards per deposit (fee mint + user mint) causes a reward-distribution discrepancy, needs an end-to-end trace (REW-004).

candidates.title: Market cap / market-removal / withdraw-queue reallocation (MetaMorpho-class) — deep pass
candidates.description: submitCap/acceptCap/submitMarketRemoval/updateWithdrawQueue/reallocate + _maxDeposit mirror MetaMorpho; the Silo-novel risk is the interaction with the reward layer (a removed market still a notification receiver/claiming-logic source) and PublicAllocator flow caps. Needs the full reallocate + queue-removal trace to find a non-inherited bug.

candidates.title: Reward delegatecall + notification run external calls inside _update (reentrancy window)
candidates.description: SiloVault._update calls _claimRewards() (delegatecall to claiming-logics that make external reward-claim calls) and _afterTokenTransfer() (external receiver calls) around super._update. deposit/withdraw use _nonReentrantOn, but a reward-claim callback executing mid-_update (before balances finalize) is a reentrancy surface; confirm transfer()/all entrypoints hold the lock and that the delegatecall logic can't reenter share ops.

candidates.title: Notification-receiver / claiming-logic callback can revert or reenter on every share op
candidates.description: Callback trace: entrypoint deposit/withdraw/redeem/transfer → _update → (1) _claimRewards delegatecall logics (external claims), (2) super._update mutates balances/totalSupply, (3) _afterTokenTransfer → receiver.afterTokenTransfer. State during callback: balances mid-mutation; cross-contract: vault↔controller reward state. A reverting callback bricks the op (DoS, DT-001); a reentrant callback hits balances before finalize. nonReentrant covers deposit/withdraw; verify it covers transfer and the delegatecall path.

candidates.title: _claimRewards delegatecalls claiming-logics in the vault storage context (trust + reentrancy surface)
candidates.description: _claimRewards delegatecalls each owner-submitted claiming-logic, executing in SiloVault's storage context; the logic also makes external reward-claim calls mid-_update (before super._update). Owner+timelock gating makes this trusted, but the blast radius (arbitrary vault storage write; reentrancy window) is large; whether transfer() holds the reentrancy lock during _update should be confirmed.

candidates.title: ERC4626 fee-share + conversion reviewed; rounding favors vault, OZ virtual-share offset present
candidates.description: deposit/mint/withdraw/redeem accrue fee shares via _accruedFeeShares (uses totalSupply + newTotalAssets-feeAssets, Floor) and convert with _convertTo*WithTotals; _decimalsOffset provides OZ virtual-share inflation protection. Reviewed: rounding directions protect existing holders; donation handled by lastTotalAssets model. Residual: confirm feeShares minting order vs reward accrual (REW-004) and zero-share deposit revert.

candidates.title: Reward emission math under very small totalStaked — deep pass
candidates.description: When totalStaked is tiny (1 wei share) the per-share index increment emission*elapsed*1e36/totalStaked can be very large; confirm no overflow of the uint index and no truncation that lets a 1-share holder capture a full emission. Needs the exact _updateAssetStateInternal formula bounds.

candidates.title: Vault roles + incentives-module access reviewed (Owner/Curator/Allocator/Guardian; acceptLogic permissionless-after-timelock)
candidates.description: Reviewed: SiloVault uses MetaMorpho role model (onlyOwner/onlyCuratorRole/onlyAllocatorRole/onlyGuardianRole) + Ownable2Step + PendingLib timelocks. VaultIncentivesModule submit/remove claiming-logic + addNotificationReceiver are onlyOwner; acceptIncentivesClaimingLogic is permissionless but only finalizes an owner-submitted, timelock-elapsed pending (standard). No missing-auth found. removeNotificationReceiver gated by _allProgramsStopped (see DT-001 DoS angle).

candidates.title: Factory + module initializer reviewed (init-once via initializer; Ownable2Step init)
candidates.description: VaultIncentivesModule.__VaultIncentivesModule_init uses the OZ initializer modifier (init-once) and __Ownable_init; SiloVaultsFactory/IdleVaultsFactory deploy via Clones. Confirm the cloned module/vault cannot be re-initialized by a front-runner (initializer guard present). No re-init path found at this depth.

candidates.title: Reward index precision (PRECISION=36) and fee-share rounding reviewed
candidates.description: DistributionManager uses index PRECISION=36 (1e36) reducing reward-index rounding; _accruedFeeShares acknowledges feeAssets may round to 0 (mulDiv(fee,WAD)). Reviewed: high-precision index; fee rounding-to-zero is documented/benign. Residual: emission*elapsed/totalStaked rounding in _updateAssetStateInternal under tiny totalStaked.

candidates.title: No flash-loan surface in scope
candidates.description: No flash-loan/flash-mint in scope (flash-mint is explicitly out of scope per README).

candidates.title: No oracle surface in the in-scope vault layer
candidates.description: The SiloVault + incentives scope reads no price oracle directly (the vault sits over ERC4626 markets; pricing/liquidation live in the out-of-scope Silo core). No oracle vulnerability surface in scope.

candidates.title: SiloVault uses OZ ERC20Permit unchanged (no custom permit logic)
candidates.description: SiloVault is itself the share token and inherits openzeppelin5 ERC20Permit (EIP-2612) without overriding permit/_useNonce/_approve. Reviewed: token_address (the vault), spender, owner_signer, nonce, deadline, and EIP-712 domain separator are handled by audited OZ code; no custom permit path that could authorize unintended asset movement. Multicall + permit interaction reviewed (no signed-permit front-run beyond the known OZ griefing, which is out of scope).

candidates.title: In-scope token handling uses SafeERC20; FoT/rebasing/approval-race are OUT OF SCOPE
candidates.description: Asset + reward transfers use OZ SafeERC20 (safeTransfer/safeTransferFrom). Per the README weird-ERC20 table, fee-on-transfer, rebasing, approval-race/reset, blocklists, high-decimals are explicitly OUT OF SCOPE — so non-standard-ERC20 findings are ineligible. Reviewed the in-scope handling: standard ERC20 assumed; SafeERC20 covers missing-bool-return.
